title: Scholarships: merit-based
summary: Girish Reddy, IWA Bonn, Ranga Raju, Kanchi Kamakoti, Mithigiri, Vasanth Rau.

posts.md:
These scholarships recognize academic excellence, outstanding JEE performance, Merit-cum-Means eligibility, and exceptional achievements.

## Girish Reddy Scholarship

### Eligibility

**Category 1**
- Two scholarships awarded based on the **highest JEE Rank**.
- Parents' annual income not exceeding **₹5,00,000**.

**Category 2**
- One scholarship awarded based on the **best all-round performance** during previous school years.
- Parents' annual income not exceeding **₹5,00,000**.

### Benefits
- ₹25,000 per year.
- Renewable subject to maintaining a **minimum GPA of 8.0**.

## Indian Women's Association at Bonn Scholarship

### Eligibility
- Based on **JEE Rank**.
- Parents' annual income up to **₹5,00,000**.
- Awarded to **one B.Tech student**.

### Benefits
- ₹1,250 per month for **12 months**.

## Sri V. Ranga Raju Memorial Scholarship

### Eligibility
- Awarded on **Merit-cum-Means** basis.
- Parents' annual income up to **₹5,00,000**.
- If Merit-cum-Means scores are equal, preference is given to **students from rural areas**.
- Renewal requires a **minimum GPA of 5.0** every semester.

### Benefits
- ₹500 per month for **4 years**.

## Kanchi Kamakoti Jagadguru Sri Chandrasekarendra Saraswathi Endowment Award

### Eligibility
- Awarded on **Merit-cum-Means** basis.
- Parents' annual income up to **₹5,50,000**.

### Benefits
- One-time Award of **₹2,500**.

## M. Sankaraiah & M. Saradha (Mithigiri) Scholarship

### Eligibility
- Open to **B.Tech / Dual Degree Electrical Engineering** students.
- Awarded based on the **highest CGPA at the end of the 4th semester**.

### Benefits
- One-time Award of **₹20,000**.

## Dr. K. Vasanth Rau Scholarship

### Eligibility
- Based on **JEE Rank**.
- Parents' annual income up to **₹5,50,000**.
- Renewable subject to maintaining a **minimum GPA of 6.5**.
- Awarded to **one student** for the entire duration of the programme.

### Benefits
- ₹25,000 per year.
